name: Potion of Flying

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour: a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover.
text: Cloudy white flecks drift through the clear liquid, which rises to the top of the vessel. For 1 hour after drinking it you can fly, with a Fly Speed matching your Speed, and you can hover. Should the potion expire while you are airborne, you fall unless something else keeps you up.
